newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Support spreads for Argentina Aug 14 strike.
newsitem.headline: Support spreads for Argentina Aug 14 strike.

text.p: The political arm of Argentina's pro-government labor federation CGT said Friday it was endorsing a general strike called for August 14 by dissident unions.
The 62 Organizations also rejected a preliminary agreement on labor reforms signed by the CGT and the government.
"When workers have no rights to make (wage) claims, then the only thing to do is to strike," 62 Organizations leader Lorenzo Miguel told reporters.
"What the CGT is trying to do is not to reach a two-way agreement to improve labor conditions, but rather to undercut the rights obtained by workers and the victories achieved by the labor movement."
Maverick unions called the strike to protest economic austerity and labor reforms.
